# GUI Interface Description: Visual Studio Code Marketplace - Rainbow CSV Extension

## System and Browser Environment

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by the "Activities" button in the top-left corner of the screen and the application dock on the left side).
- **Web Browser**: Google Chrome.
- **Browser Window Title**: "Rainbow CSV - Visual Studio Code Marketplace".
- **Browser Tab**: "Rainbow CSV - Visual Studio Code Marketplace".
- **Browser Address Bar**: `marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=mechatroner.rainbow-csv`.
- **Browser UI Elements**:
  - **Navigation Buttons**: Back, Forward, and Reload buttons on the left side of the address bar.
  - **User Account**: A user profile icon (blue person silhouette) on the right side of the address bar.
  - **Update Notification**: A "Finish update" button next to the user profile icon.
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon for searching within the marketplace.
  - **Sign In Button**: "Sign in" text on the top-right of the header.
  - **System Tray**: Located at the top-right corner, showing icons for network, sound, and power.

## Application Dock (Left Sidebar)

- **Application Icons**:
  - Google Chrome (top)
  - Thunderbird (email client)
  - Visual Studio Code (blue icon with a stylized "VS")
  - VLC Media Player (orange traffic cone)
  - LibreOffice Writer (blue document icon)
  - LibreOffice Calc (green spreadsheet icon)
  - LibreOffice Impress (orange presentation icon)
  - GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program, gray dog icon)
  - File Manager (gray folder icon)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange shopping bag icon)
  - Help (blue question mark icon)
  - Trash (green recycle bin icon)
  - **Application Grid**: A 3x3 grid icon at the bottom for accessing all applications.

## Visual Studio Code Marketplace Header

- **Logo and Title**: "Visual Studio | Marketplace" with the Visual Studio Code logo (a stylized "VS" in a square).
- **Breadcrumb Navigation**: "Visual Studio Code > Programming Languages > Rainbow CSV".
- **New User Prompt**: "New to Visual Studio Code? Get it now." with a blue hyperlink.
- **User Authentication**: "Sign in" text on the top-right.

## Extension Page Content

### Extension Title and Metadata

- **Extension Name**: "Rainbow CSV" (large, bold text).
- **Author**: "mechatroner" (hyperlinked).
- **Installation Statistics**: "24,666,217 installs" (with a download icon).
- **Rating**: 5 stars (with "(163)" indicating the number of reviews).
- **Pricing**: "Free".
- **Description**: "Highlight CSV and TSV files, Run SQL-like queries".

### Installation Section

- **Instruction**: "Launch VS Code Quick Open (Ctrl+P), paste the following command, and press enter."
- **Command Field**: A text box containing the command `ext install mechatroner.rainbow-csv`.
- **Copy Button**: A "Copy" button next to the command field.
- **More Info Link**: A "More Info" hyperlink.

### Navigation Tabs

- **Active Tab**: "Overview" (underlined in blue).
- **Other Tabs**: "Version History", "Q & A", "Rating & Review".

## Main Content Area

### Overview Section

- **Section Title**: "Rainbow CSV".
- **Main Features**:
  - Highlights columns in CSV, TSV, semicolon, and pipe-separated files with distinct colors.
  - Query, transform, and filter data using a built-in SQL-like language (RBQL).
  - Augmented tracking of up to 3 columns of interest with auxiliary decorations.
  - Align columns graphically or with extra spaces and Shrink (trim spaces from fields).
  - Optional sticky header line.
  - Provide info about column on hover.
  - Automatic CSV consistency checks (CSVLint).
  - Optional alternating row background colors for improved readability.
  - Multi-cursor column edit.
  - Copy in Excel and Markdown format for export.
  - Works in browser (vscode.dev).

### Preview Section

- **Embedded Visual Studio Code Preview**:
  - **File Path**: `movies.csv` (in the file explorer on the left).
  - **Editor Content**: A CSV file with columns: `original_title, year, duration, genre, director, avg_vote`.
  - **Sample Data**:
    - Row 10: `Blade Runner,1982,117,"Action, Sci-Fi, Thriller","Ridley Scott,8.1`
    - Row 17: `The Matrix,1999,136,"Action, Sci-Fi","Lana Wachowski
